purpose: UI layout proposals for phase text and hand count; no runtime changes

variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / precise-object-edit.
Input image 1 is the actual existing game screenshot and edit target. Produce a polished HIGH-FIDELITY redesign mockup for this exact Chinese Cthulhu card game, preserving its established warm oxidized brass, dark teal stone and carved book/tentacle relief art. Preserve landscape 1440:900 composition and crisp legible UI typography.
The narrow full-width rectangular phase/message panel immediately above the hand area looks wrong now that the hand area has a curved silhouette. Remove that entire old rectangle, including its long border. Remove the old loose red hand count label next to the confirm button. Rehouse exactly those two information elements in the new design described below.
Keep the upper player panels, HP/SAN bars, deck piles and adventure log composition exactly as shown. Keep all FIVE existing face-up hand cards and their EXISTING artworks, portrait proportions exactly 392:590, scale, 20% overlap and fan curvature; do not narrow or stretch any card. Keep the sculpted left candle/book/tentacle and right book/tentacle style, brass curved table edge, and established confirm-button material. Keep the cards large. No new enemy zones, support zones, mana, health systems, extra actions or card costs. Do not add a card hover enlargement.
All three designs use the same actual game state: 5 cards held, limit 4, one card needs discarding, none yet selected. Exact readable new Chinese text: "请弃置 1 张手牌" and secondary "已选 0 / 1". Counter must identify itself as "手牌" plus larger "5 / 4". Existing button text "确认弃牌" (inactive until a card is chosen). Use muted amber/ivory for instruction, restrained rust red only for excess count, avoid tiny near-black copy. The information form must have credible space for up to two lines of longer instructions and optional countdown badges in other game states. Keep all copy horizontal, not curved/warped around a ring.
Do not add explanatory arrows, annotations, watermark, comparison-board labels, duplicate UI or fake browser chrome. Output a single complete game-screen proposal, not a mood board. Keep finish grounded and implementable as layered bitmap assets with live text.
DESIGN A — TABLE-EDGE INSCRIPTION WITH BOOK-CLASP COUNT.
New phase message: short, floating, HORIZONTAL inscription between the board and fan, visually following the center of the table arc through its framing only. Place at approx x=600–1040, y=520–565, to the RIGHT of the existing left-side confirm action. Center the primary sentence and secondary progress in two readable lines, with only tiny brass end ornaments, a subtle dark feathered shadow and a fine split curved underline. It should feel inscribed into the dark air/stone, not boxed inside a rectangular banner. Leave at least 25px of clear space above the nearest card top, including room for the 22px hover lift. Keep confirm button around x=405–555,y=535–580.
New count: replace a small existing metal clasp area on the upper-middle cover of the LEFT sculpted book with a compact organically edged bronze book-clasp badge, approx x=205–285,y=704–760, displaying small "手牌" over clear "5 / 4". This is attached to the book prop, outside the card area, styled as a physical clasp rather than a floating rectangle. The rest of the book artwork remains. No extra flat banner under the game board. Preserve all five card positions and prop positions.

DESIGN B — LEFT BOOKMARK COMMAND TAG.
Consolidate the instruction, discard progress and hand counter into one attached bookmark-like command tag rising diagonally OUT OF THE LEFT BOOK PROP, at approx x=225–580,y=500–557. Main line "请弃置 1 张手牌" and below "已选 0 / 1". A small round bronze seal fixed on the RIGHT tip of this SAME tag displays "手牌" and "5 / 4"; do not repeat the counter elsewhere. Leave extra blank horizontal room for longer copy. Connect tag visually to the existing left book through a narrow leather bookmark strip.
Move the existing confirm button slightly left to x=300–450,y=558–602, directly under the instruction tag and outside the card fan. Keep it identical in size/material to the real button. Main card fan and right book sculpture stay exactly in place; text/tag must not cover any card or enter the hover area. Restore open stone background across the rest of the old full-width prompt panel. Avoid large framed rectangular notification panels and bright parchment. This proposal should keep the center of the scene open.

To create real space for this lower inscription, move the ENTIRE hand fan, both left and right relief props and the matching curved brass edge UP by exactly 48px as a single rigid composition. Do not scale, narrow, change overlap, change aspect ratio or alter individual card geometry. The old full-width prompt bar is removed, so this upward shift uses its freed space. Keep the existing confirm button at the LEFT above the cards (approx x=340–490,y=494–538), adjacent to the book, clear of all card tops including hover clearance. The lower nameplate must not cover any card bottom, and all five cards must remain fully visible. Maintain the original overall screen dimensions and upper game board. No new buttons or systems.
